::: notes
Combined Lessons 1–2 from the original seven-part program. This is Lesson 1 of the revised seven-deck sequence. Allow 70–90 minutes across teaching periods if needed, with a possible break before Examples 2.3–2.4. The opening precedes the objective: signed 1D motion, then a turn in 2D. Students already know a little signed 1D motion. The cover shows two vectors placed head to tail and their resultant. Complete worked examples in OneNote. Source: 12MAX1 – Introduction to Vectors, printed pp. 1–13; Program.pdf, original Lessons 1–2. See TEACHER_GUIDE.md.
:::
